text: Yendor is a third-person expedition roguelike shooter built in Unity. Models assist development; the game must run without AI services.
A seed currently controls decoration and enemy-position inputs; topology is fixed. This does not guarantee exact cross-machine gameplay replay.
Author scenes and prefabs through Editor tooling. Preserve asset meta identity; never manually rewrite Unity scene or prefab YAML.
Compilation, runtime smoke, rendered inspection and manual feel testing establish different things. Report each independently and link actual evidence.
Beads is the local task authority. GitHub issues present user-facing work when connected. Avoid independent backlogs or automatic promotion of agent observations to decisions.
